row.title: DOCS-SYNC-1: public docs and site links are checked against code
row.body: scripts/check_readmes.py with doctrine/readmes.json runs in checks and in the seed. It fails on a missing required README section, a broken relative link, an ultrastable.io link the site code does not route, a site href to an unrouted path, an unregistered claim block, outdated wording, and (with --archived) a retired repository whose README does not point straight at ultrastable/ultrastable. The check found the dead /year link; it now redirects to /year/failures. Verified: check_readmes passes with 0 findings, claims and claimcode checks pass.
